title: Quotidian
summary: QUOTID'IAN, adjective [Latin quotidianus; quotus and dies.] Daily; occurring or returning daily; as a quotidian fever. QUOTID'IAN, noun 1. A fever whose paroxysms return every day. 2. Any thing return
